thought.text: JDK 21 is installed. Let me check what openapi-generator version the app pins, then restart pnpm install with JAVA_HOME set:

reasoning_content:
JDK 21 is already installed. The openapi-generator-cli 2.41.0 wrapper, when no version is pinned in openapitools.json, downloads the generator JAR (openapi-generator-cli-7.x.jar, about 25MB) from repo1.maven.org, then runs it with `java -jar`. Since JAVA_HOME is currently set, the `pnpm install` → prepare → generate:api path should work.

Pre-download the openapi generator jar? The CLI downloads to `node_modules/@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli/versions/`. If a version is pinned in the openapitools json, it fetches that version. Let me check which version is pinned in the openapitools json file.

After that, restart pnpm install with JAVA_HOME set.

action.command: cd /workspace/app; grep -h "version" openapitools-*.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; echo "=== check nx targets for generate-backend-api ==="; grep -rn "generate-backend-api" apps/app/project.json libs/*/project.json 2>/dev/null | head -3
